They Might Be Giants are no strangers to radio! 📻 When John Linnell and John Flansburgh of TMBG visited The Current studio for a chat with host Zach McCormick, they had a message for radio stations worldwide.

They Might Be Giants are in the Twin Cities for a series of shows at venues in Minneapolis and St. Paul. Check The Current’s Gig List for all the details: https://thecurrent.org/giglist

author: The Current
description:
Watch The Union feat. Phil Cook perform "I Come to Praise His Name" live in an Eau Claire coffeehouse
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

When the Eaux Claires Festival returned in the summer of 2026, The Current and Radio Milwaukee teamed up for a live broadcast from Shift Coffee Bar in Eau Claire, Wisconsin.

On Saturday, July 25, just one day after performing an uplifting set at the Eaux Claires Festival at Carson Park, The Union feat. Phil Cook showed up bright and early at SHIFT to a set of three songs, including the original, "There Was a Time," off their 2025 album, "Eclectic."

Watch a performance of "I Come to Praise His Name" above.
